decisions_recap: Both region tools live in the one `marquee` leaf because the blueprint and 04 §5.2 list only that leaf (NEW-1); no invented structure.

The confidence gate is a derived predicate, not a column: extraction='ocr' with confidence < 0.70 is needs-correction; a below-gate mark still writes so the user keeps it, and 020 excludes it from Result input via isResultEligible().
OCR is fail-soft and crop-only; Tesseract confidence is normalized 0-100 -> 0-1 at the seam so the gate is one number.
PageStage touch-action corrected to 03 §7 (none only while drawing, else touch-pan-x pan-y), overriding 009's global touch-none.
PageStage gained onCanvasRendered (mirrors 010's onTextLayerRendered) so a features container can crop z0 without a canvas leaf importing @feature/* (I3).
The stored bbox colour stays null (highlight-layer resolves the token, as in 010); only the live stroke takes a colour.
A disarmed, fixture-free Marquee renders nothing: g2's 'scrolling works' is structural, not a runtime check.
tesseract.js ^7 was added (the plan names Tesseract); npm audit reported 0 vulnerabilities.
